parsed.post: My latest experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.05 (1.018728) was worse than my previous best (1.000234). It seems 0.04 was actually better for this high-capacity configuration. Reverting to 0.04. I will now try to increase the WEIGHT_DECAY slightly to see if it improves regularization/generalization.
parsed.description: Reverting MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and introducing a small WEIGHT_DECAY of 0.01 to improve stability/generalization.
